en-US.title: [Baetyo] I spent half a week on one event 👍 2025 #PlayExpo VLOG 🎮 #cosplay
en-US.description:
Hello everyone! I'm the Belly Fat Belly Fat Fairy!

After attending the 4th and 5th Duolingo events,
I didn't even have time to regroup until [PlayXpo]! 🎮

PlayXpo is a gaming-focused event,
and it's a large-scale event held on Thursday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday...
So, I packed two days for the general public (focused on hands-on activities) and two days for cosplay. ☺️

With the benefit of 100% free admission with a pre-registration,
there were so many fun things to do. * There were so many booths *
Compared to other cosplay events (Comic World, Ilpae, etc.),
I really liked how there were so many more game cosplayers! 👍

Even though it was only 2-3 months ago, 😅
I hope those who went to PlayXpo can reminisce about the fun they had,
and those who didn't can enjoy the vicarious experience.
I hope you enjoy watching it!

Thank you for watching my video today! 🙌
